traits: Cap up to 15 cm, red to orange, sticky when moist, convex to flat or depressed
Gills pale, turning yellowish, sometimes staining greyish
White flesh that blackens when bruised; mild taste and smell
Mixed woods and under conifers, alone or in groups
safetyNote: Edible: the DGfM and the VAPKO list it. Wikipedia (en) advises against eating wild ones because of look-alikes of unknown edibility, without naming them; its flesh blackens when bruised. The red cap and the blackening are what the page gives. It has no French Wikipedia page: the text comes from Wikipedia (en) and the DGfM; the page is short.

sources.title: Deutsche Gesellschaft für Mykologie (DGfM), Fachausschuss Pilzverwertung und Toxikologie (2026). Positivliste der Speisepilze, Stand 1. Mai 2026.
VAPKO, Vereinigung amtlicher Pilzkontrollorgane der Schweiz (2023). Empfehlungsliste (liste des champignons recommandés), version 09.2023.
